scope: All built-in Phrase Library entries, including Motion Catalog. Metadata triage covers every entry; only the cited candidates received individual reference review. Skipped does not mean the existing animation is known to be incorrect. Previously customized clips are preserved.

reasons.updated: Reference-based movement adjustment; still awaiting signer validation.
reasons.no_motion: No playable lexical motion is mapped. Please specify fingerspelling or the intended phrase and movements.
reasons.variant: Multiple regional variants are documented. Please choose which movement to use.
reasons.closure: The timing and contact of the index, middle finger, and thumb closure have not been verified on this rig.
reasons.rig: A reference-based candidate was tried but withdrawn because rig checks left unresolved wrist, finger, speed, or contact concerns.
reasons.mapping: The entry uses an approximate English-to-sign mapping. Its intended meaning and a complete movement reference need confirmation.
reasons.contact: Metadata indicates contact, but the full hand orientation, contact point, and timing have not been individually verified against a signing reference.
reasons.fingers: Metadata indicates finger changes, but their complete sequence and timing have not been individually verified against a signing reference.
reasons.coordination: The two-hand movement and relative orientation have not been individually verified against a complete signing reference.
reasons.reference: A complete signing reference has not been individually checked. Descriptor metadata alone is insufficient to confidently replace this animation.
